summary: A stack of three full-width outlined neutral Buttons with align="between": label at the start, a Kbd hint at the end; the last one is loading and keeps its spinner at the start.
use: Action grids and menus of full-width buttons where the label is left-aligned and the shortcut sits on the right.
spec: Each `<Button variant="outlined" tone="neutral" align="between" fullWidth trailingHint>` with a `<Kbd>` in `trailing`: Open lead (O), Assign to me (A)
Third button Syncing (R) also has `loading`, so the spinner replaces the leading slot while the label stays left
